{{Otheruses|Analysis}}
'''''An Analysis of Crisis''''' was a report delivered by the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] to the [[New Republic Provisional Council]] shortly after the end of the [[Thrawn campaign]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. Among its known contents were biographical profiles of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]].<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook">[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]</ref>
